_comment: Photos for the four 55+ community pages, batch 2026-10-a. Found on Wikimedia Commons: 18 on 2026-10-07, 19 more on 2026-10-10. Only CC0, public domain, CC BY and CC BY-SA. None shows a community itself: Commons has no photo of any of the four. Each photo shows the area around it; the 'what' line says where. Each record has a 600w and a 1200w WebP file (variants, made with tools/photos.js from the Commons 1920 or 1280 px thumbnail; resized, nothing else changed), width and height of the 1200w file, default alt text, the photo's Commons title, and how it reached Commons (provenance). 'file' is the older single 1200 px file that the 2026-10-07 specs use; the 2026-10-10 photos have only the variants. A photo with 'hold' may not be used; tools/photos.js refuses it. Use tools/photos.js (heroPhoto, gallery, featureCards, creditsList), which links the license and the source. Rules: rules/images.md. CC BY-SA: if a photo is cropped or edited, the edited version carries the same license.
